recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, horizontally split composition featuring a group of four men in dark casual attire against a vibrant blue studio background, topped with a large-scale typographic header on a white field.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the stark white upper third and the saturated blue lower two-thirds
Scale relationship between the oversized primary text and the smaller secondary text
Alignment of the band members along a subtle horizontal dividing line
Color coordination between the primary text and the studio backdrop
coreInvariants: Horizontal split at approximately the 30% mark
Monochromatic blue background with a central soft-glow vignette
Subject matter consisting of four male figures in dark clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects positioned waist-up, evenly spaced across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold blue text spanning the width of the upper section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large blue text, moves up to the smaller gray text, then drops down to scan the faces of the subjects from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the very top and blue space around the subjects to prevent crowding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue used for the background and primary text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white used for the top header background and thin horizontal divider.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Medium gray for secondary subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue tones contrasted against neutral black clothing and white backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blue, white, black, and gray
Avoid warm tones in the background

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking (touching or nearly touching characters)

composition.position: Top third, centered vertically within the white space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and scale contrast between a heavy geometric display and a light condensed subtitle.
graphicDevices: Thin white horizontal line separating the blue background from the subjects' lower bodies

preserve: Tight kerning of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, neutral geometric structure of the main title.
Appropriate for the light, lowercase subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four men in black jackets and shirts, standing in a row against a vibrant blue wall with a soft central light. Leave the top 30% of the image as a solid white horizontal bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold blue geometric sans-serif with very tight kerning in the white area. Place a smaller subtitle in light gray condensed sans-serif directly above it.

verificationChecks: Is the main text blue and the subtitle gray?
Are the letters in the main title nearly touching?
Is there a clear horizontal split between the white and blue sections?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue background vignette
Number of subjects in the portrait
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any existing brand logos or trademarks
Exact clothing details like specific zipper placements
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the blue of the text matches the blue of the background
Verify the white divider line is straight and thin
Confirm the subtitle is entirely lowercase
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1/3 white top header with a 2/3 blue studio portrait; use bold, tightly-kerned blue sans-serif for the primary brand name.
